text:
Dear Lumen Health team,

In my five years of experience designing patient-facing products at a telehealth startup, I have honed my skills in Figma and user research, which I understand are crucial for the Product Designer role. My recent work included leading the redesign of our appointment booking flow, achieving a remarkable reduction in drop-off rates by a third. This experience showcased my ability to create intuitive user experiences that address real user needs.

I am particularly proud of establishing a component library used by three product teams. This initiative not only streamlined our design process but also fostered consistency across various products. My proficiency in prototyping has enabled me to create high-fidelity mockups that effectively communicate design concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Running weekly usability sessions with patients and clinicians has been a key part of my process. These sessions provided invaluable insights that I translate into prioritized backlogs, ensuring that user feedback directly informs our design decisions. This approach aligns with my desire to work in a team where research shapes the roadmap, as I believe that understanding the user is paramount for successful product development.

I am eager to bring my expertise in design systems and user-centered design to Lumen Health, contributing to innovative solutions that enhance the patient experience.

Sincerely,
